external_test.unit: image-level agreement with supplied folder labels

kavaratti.unit: method-dependent estimate; no reviewed Kavaratti ground truth

method.yolo: original best.pt, CPU, imgsz=640, conf=0.25; image positive if any class-0 detection; video fraction from detected mask pixels; no detection gives null
method.hsv: OpenCV HSV: pale S<=60 and V>=180; brown H=10..30, S>=80, V=50..200; fraction pale/(pale+brown); max dimension 640

limits: External scores are for image classification on supplied Flickr labels, not Kavaratti accuracy.
YOLO and HSV video percentages use different denominators and are estimates.
No reviewed Kavaratti test masks or frame GPS are available.
